products.name: Jet Marvel Captain America Edition Helmet
products.description: Disney Jet Marvel comes with a high-impact ABS Material Shell and Aerodynamic design. Removable and washable lining, it is also odor resistant helping the helmet stay fresher, and longer in between cleaning. This helmet is ISI Certified which comes with a quick-release metallic buckle, an optical polycarbonate visor with scratch and UV resistance, and an easy mechanism. It gives total assurance of safety and riding freely on the roads. Weighs upto 900±50gms.

products.name: Junior Buds OF Beetle Helmet
products.description: The kids’ helmet featuring a beetle graphic is an adorable and playful accessory designed specifically for young riders. This helmet combines safety with a delightful beetle design, making it both functional and visually appealing. The helmet is primarily made with a sturdy and impact-resistant outer shell, ensuring the highest level of protection for your child’s head. The colors of the beetle helmet evoke a sense of energy and excitement, perfectly suited for young riders.
